body.query: What are the architectures and reported results of open-source autonomous coding agents and frameworks: OpenHands (All Hands), SWE-agent / mini-swe-agent, Block's goose, and Sourcegraph Amp? Focus on the agent-computer interface, sandboxing, and lessons from SWE-bench-style evaluation.
